description: W1-B1, run against the REAL vault rather than against the filesystem. Two files are declared whose names differ only in case, Model.safetensors and model.safetensors, with DIFFERENT bytes. On a case-sensitive filesystem that is two files and two leaves. On NTFS the second write lands on the first file, so the directory holds ONE entry: the FIRST name carrying the SECOND file's bytes. This scenario does not assert what the vault should do about that — nobody has measured it yet. It asserts only the things that must hold either way, and records the manifest for reading.

assert.note: the non-colliding file must still be captured — without this, a vault that refused EVERYTHING would satisfy every other assertion here
and its bytes reach the witness, so the run is a real capture and not an empty one
